tui.busy_delivery.queue_notice.note: Shown when a message sent to a working turn is queued without interrupting: it waits for this step and the tools keep running. Kept within a few characters of both_notice so the rendered height matches.

tui.busy_delivery.both_notice.note: Shown when a message sent to a working turn is queued and escalates to a steer (an interrupt) if it sits too long (about 45 seconds): it waits first, tools keep running, then it interrupts like a steer. Kept within a few characters of queue_notice so the rendered height matches.
